full_text_en:
Zigong Ziliujing District State-owned Assets Management Investment Co., Ltd. v. Sichuan Lianzheng Engineering Consulting Co., Ltd. — dispute over service contract

Ruling Summary

A judicial appraisal conclusion issued by a forensic appraisal institution entrusted by a people's court is merely one piece of litigation evidence and is not actionable. Where a party raises an objection to an appraisal conclusion and directly files a lawsuit with a people's court seeking confirmation that the appraisal conclusion is invalid, such a lawsuit does not fall within the scope of civil litigation accepted by the people's court and shall be dismissed by ruling in accordance with the law.

Plaintiff: Zigong Ziliujing District State-owned Assets Management Investment Co., Ltd., domiciled at: Dangui Avenue, Zigong City, Sichuan Province.
Legal Representative: Zhang Minghong, Manager of the Company.

Defendant: Sichuan Lianzheng Engineering Consulting Co., Ltd., domiciled at: Erhuan Road, Jinniu District, Chengdu City, Sichuan Province.
Legal Representative: Zhang Jiahua, Manager of the Company.

The plaintiff, Zigong Ziliujing District State-owned Assets Management Investment Co., Ltd. (hereinafter referred to as Guotou Company), filed a lawsuit with the Jinniu District People's Court of Chengdu City, Sichuan Province, against the defendant, Sichuan Lianzheng Engineering Consulting Co., Ltd. (hereinafter referred to as Lianzheng Company), over a dispute concerning a service contract.

Plaintiff's Allegations: With the court's permission, the defendant Lianzheng Company issued the "Judicial Appraisal Report on the Quantity of Earth and Stone in the Leveling Earthwork Project of the Shuping Carton Factory of Zigong Huaxin Weiye Company" (hereinafter referred to as the "Judicial Appraisal Report") on October 13, 2010. However, the defendant's judicial appraiser, Zhang Chunguang, was merely a cost estimator and did not have the qualifications to act as a judicial appraiser for the quantity of earth and stone in the leveling earthwork project. The plaintiff requested that the people's court rule: (1) that the "Judicial Appraisal Report" issued by Lianzheng Company be declared invalid; and (2) that the defendant refund the appraisal fee of RMB 25,000.

Defendant's Defense: 1. The judicial appraiser, Zhang Chunguang, possesses the qualifications for engineering cost review and has appraisal qualifications. 2. On June 10, 2010, the company accepted a commission from the Zigong Intermediate People's Court to appraise the quantity of earth and stone in the leveling earthwork project of the Zigong Shuping Carton Factory. Most of the materials for the case were transferred to the company by the Zigong Intermediate People's Court, and the materials supplemented by both parties were subject to cross-examination in accordance with judicial procedures. After conducting a site inspection, the appraisers verified, analyzed in depth, and calculated the materials item by item, ultimately forming the appraisal report, and made a statement correcting errors in terminology contained therein.

Facts Found by the Court at First Instance (Jinniu District People's Court of Chengdu City):

In the course of hearing the dispute over a construction contract between Zigong Nengtong Construction Engineering Company (hereinafter referred to as Nengtong Company) and the plaintiff Guotou Company, the Zigong Intermediate People's Court, by means of the "Appraisal Commission Letter" (No. (2010) Zi Zhi Wei Zi No. 7) dated June 22, 2010, entrusted the defendant Lianzheng Company to appraise the quantity of earth and stone in the leveling earthwork project of the Shuping Carton Factory of Zigong Huaxin Weiye Company located in the Shuping Industrial Park, Zigong City. On October 13, 2010, Lianzheng Company issued the "Judicial Appraisal Report."

Opinion of the Court at First Instance (Jinniu District People's Court of Chengdu City):

In the course of hearing the dispute over the construction contract between Nengtong Company and the plaintiff Guotou Company, the defendant Lianzheng Company, accepting the commission from the Zigong Intermediate People's Court, conducted a judicial appraisal of the quantity of earth and stone involved in the project and issued the "Judicial Appraisal Report." If Guotou Company has objections to the appraisal conclusions in the "Judicial Appraisal Report," it may apply to the Zigong Intermediate People's Court for a reappraisal in accordance with Article 27 of the Provisions of the Supreme People's Court on Evidence in Civil Proceedings. The "Judicial Appraisal Report" is in the nature of evidence collected by the court upon investigation; whether it is to be admitted should be determined by the Zigong Intermediate People's Court in the case of the dispute over the construction contract between Nengtong Company and Guotou Company. A party's direct lawsuit against the appraisal institution seeking confirmation that the appraisal conclusion is invalid does not fall within the scope of civil litigation accepted by the people's court.

Accordingly, pursuant to Article 108(4) of the Civil Procedure Law of the People's Republic of China, the Jinniu District People's Court of Chengdu City rendered a ruling on May 16, 2011:

Dismiss the plaintiff Guotou Company's lawsuit.

After the judgment of first instance was pronounced, neither party filed an appeal, and the ruling of first instance has become legally effective.
